entries.en: to be busy; to hurry, to press on with business

entries.zh: 忙迫；仓促紧迫，事情逼人
entries.en: hard-pressed; hurried and urgent
entries.notes: L 第二词 axacbatad 词形可疑（疑为 arrebatad 一类），义依 H/M「忙迫」定。

entries.en: in great haste; very hurried
urgent; to make haste, to hurry
entries.notes: L「di ligente」分词可疑，R 栏作 gūi 缺 -p 韵尾，义主要依 H「急」与 M guîp。

entries.zh: 办事急迫之人；急于成事
entries.en: one who is hasty in a matter; a person quick to press things on
entries.notes: H「急計人」与 R 栏「gūi gūi xīn」对音不合，L 亦疑读，义仅据 H 与 M「guîp quêy lāng」推。

entries.en: anxious at heart; impatient
hot-tempered by nature; naturally hasty
entries.notes: L 后段 naturalablenics 严重残损，只取其「natural-（天性）」之义与 H「急性」相合。

entries.en: pressing; urgent
hurried; rushed
swift as a spirit; amazingly quick
impatient; anxious at heart
entries.notes: L「de ora con」残断（疑 ora/coraçon），义依 H「心急」与 M「sīn guîp」。

entries.zh: 心火；心中燥热焦躁（中医内热之说）
entries.en: heart-fire; inner heat and agitation
entries.notes: L「colico en fuego」词形可疑，H「心火」与 M「sīn huē」自成语义，西语仅能大意对应。

entries.en: to press; to push down

entries.zh: 以带（或抓钩之属）按压某物
entries.en: to press something with a strap or hooked implement
entries.notes: L「garabato」（钩、抓具）与 H「按带」所指器物不对应，从 H/M 之「按」立义，器名存疑。

entries.en: to press (it) down
entries.notes: L「pegandolha tia bajid」拼写残损，然「hacia abajo（向下）」可辨，与 H「按落去」相合。

entries.en: to press in a printing press; to squeeze, to press out
entries.notes: L「emprenta」即印刷机（马尼拉华印工语境），H 字在「擲/榨」间存疑，取「压」义。

entries.en: to tamp or pound with a mallet
entries.notes: L「maci」疑为 maço（木槌），H「當」须按闽南语 tūng「捣、舂」解，方与西语相合。

entries.en: to tamp with a mallet so that it is pressed tight
entries.notes: M 栏有[残]、L 后段大段疑读，仅 H/M/R 之「當…緊」可定其大意。

entries.en: to press hard on someone; to oppress, to afflict
to press tightly; to oppress severely
entries.notes: H 第二字在「緊/縶」间存疑，义依 L「afligir」与 M「pêg guīn」。

entries.en: to squeeze or grip with the hand
entries.notes: H 首字在「抙/揸/拄」间无定，R 栏「siem chā」对音不合，仅据 L「con la mano」立义。

entries.en: to squeeze (something) to death in the hand
entries.notes: L 末段残损（ara vallo 疑读），H「抙死」首字亦存疑，仅「握压致死」一层可定。

entries.en: to twist tight; to pinch tight
entries.notes: L「racis」词形可疑（疑为 raíces 之属），义依 H「捻緊」与 M「liam guīn」。

entries.en: to twist something tight with a band or strap
entries.notes: L「con las, o con calçando」明显残损，H「捻带」与西语之对应只能作大意推定。
